intro: You have died. You must pick a game cartridge to be reincarnated into.

games.title: DEEP END
games.text:
Drink from the fountains, not the pools.
Grow food in trays behind the changing rooms.
Sleep in the warm upper lounge.
When waterfalls weaken, avoid pools and slides.
The purge currents can hold you underwater.

games.title: SUNROOM LINE
games.text:
Sleep aboard the tram.
Gather roots and water during calm stops.
Board at the first bell.
The tram leaves before the gust.
Miss it, and you're stranded.
Every supply stop permanently cools the cabin.

games.title: VELVET ORCHARD
games.text:
Pick peaches before dusk.
Boil collected water before drinking.
Sleep in the service arcade.
If the roof starts ticking, take the covered passage.
Falling glass makes supplies harder to reach.

games.title: SIGNAL 03
games.text:
Collect food and water from the nearest stocked locker.
Stay on intact tiles.
Turn back when tiles pale.
Cross outside before zero three goes dark.
Every reset removes floor, eventually cutting off supplies.
